title: FLL-12 — Fat Loss & Lift, 6 weeks
author: Aryan Bhardwaj
desc: this program is to assist in Fatloss

ex.note: 45° incline. Targets upper chest. Joint safe.
Seated to reduce lower back stress.
Set cables low pull upward. 3 sec squeeze at top.
One arm at a time on cable.
Squeeze at bottom. Don't swing.
Incline 15 / Speed 3.5
Incline 15 / Speed 3.5 / HR target 125-145 bpm
Pull to upper chest. Squeeze shoulder blades.
Drive elbows back. Pause 1 sec at chest.
Hinge at hips. Start light - 2x15kg first session.
Pull to face level. Elbows high and wide. Light weight.
Alternate arms. No swinging. Full extension at bottom.
Incline 15 / Speed 3.5
Treadmil incline more than what you do 4 min break 3 min , 4 times
Feet shoulder width mid-plate. Don't lock knees at top.
Can go slightly heavier than Wednesday.
3 second slow negative on the way down.
Full extension. 1 sec squeeze at top.
Pull rope using abs only. Don't pull with arms.
Squeeze everything. Stop if lower back hurts.
